title: What Is Kidney Stone Surgery?
description: What kidney stone surgery (ureteroscopy/lithotripsy) is, what it is for and when it is recommended. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: Surgical treatment of kidney stones removes stones that cause pain, obstruction or infection. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
Surgical treatment of kidney stones removes stones that cause pain, obstruction or infection.

How is it done?

Laser ureteroscopy, extracorporeal lithotripsy (shock waves) or percutaneous nephrolithotomy, depending on size and location.

When is it recommended?

Stones that do not pass on their own, very large stones, obstructive stones or stones with infection. The urologist decides.

At Cirugía 24 Horas

We operate in Lima with the same team across different clinics, so you can choose the price alternative that fits you. We also care for patients from abroad.

faqs.a: The surgeon, after an evaluation with tests.
